lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: You fight like someone who expects to lose.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: I fight like someone who intends to survive.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: A ranger who reads maps but trusts her gut. Which wins?

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: That ridge — something big passed through last night.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: No. I want to know it's behind us.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: Do you ever miss the quiet of a keep? Four walls, a fire, no ash in your teeth?

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: A keep is a trap waiting to be sprung. I'll take the open road.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: When this is over, where do you go?

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: Wherever the next wrong is. And you?

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: Somewhere without a name on the map.
